added_lines: the parishes of bellaghy/ballyscullion and greenlough 18 october 2026 the twenty-ninth sunday of the year world mission sunday the annual collection for the foreign missions will be taken up this weekend. this week’s diary monday 19 october: bellaghy - 11.00am mass greenlough parish pastoral council meeting: 7.30pm tuesday 20 october: greenlough - 9.30am mass wednesday 21 october: bellaghy - 9.30am mass thursday 22 october: greenlough - adoration, 9.00am – 5.00pm friday 23 october bellaghy: adoration, 10am – 8pm; rosary at 7.30pm. greenlough: 7.30pm mass in memory of all those who died during the covid pandemic. thirtieth sunday of the year saturday 24 october: greenlough - mass: 5.30pm (streamed to bellaghy) anniversary mass for rosemary madden and hugh francis madden sunday 25 october: ballyscullion: 9.45am mass bellaghy: 11.00am mass (streamed to greenlough). deaths: we offer our sympathy to the families and friends of anthony diamond , bellaghy/clady, peggy larkin, ballyscullion road, and sadie martin , newbridge, who died recently. anniversaries: vola scullion (anniversary mass at 11am); ella rose kearney (anniver sary mass at 11am); harry and lily brennan; stella maria mcneill ; teresa mckeever; mary mclarnon; sean mccartney; rose patricia (patsy) mulholland; marga ret mcerlean; margaret mcnicholl; roger hughes; marie mcneill; mary elle n mcpeake; kathleen mcauley; brigid birt; dan mcfaul; vera mcquillan; paddy rankin. anniversaries next weekend (24/25 october): patrick joseph mclaughlin; margaret doherty (1st anniversary). may they rest in peace. prayer for vocations : st paul could have written this passage from today’s second reading to our seminarians and to the men discerning their vocation: “we know, brothers, that god loves you and that you have been chosen, because when we brought the good news to you, it came to you not only as words, but as power and the holy spirit and as utter c onviction.” greenlough
